tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search the VoxelRank server list. Filter by game, tag, country and keyword, and sort it. Returns up to `limit` servers per page with address, players online, votes and links. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: One server's public details: address, version, online status, players, votes this month and in total, its rank on VoxelRank, rating, vote interval and links. No API key needed.

tools.name: top_servers
tools.description: The most voted servers this month, for one game or across all games, in order. No API key needed.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Every game VoxelRank lists, with its key and how many public servers it has. Pass a game to also get its tags, for search_servers. No API key needed.

tools.name: list_my_servers
tools.description: The listing your API key belongs to, with its review and visibility state, votes and rank. Needs your listing's API key as a Bearer token. Each listing has its own key.

tools.name: get_vote_stats
tools.description: Vote totals for your own listing: today, this month, all time, unique voters this month, rank, and a per-day count for the last `days` days. Needs your listing's API key.

tools.name: recent_votes
tools.description: Votes for your own listing in the last `hours` hours, oldest first: vote id, in-game name, time (unix seconds) and whether your plugin has claimed the reward. Pass the answer's next_after as `after` to get the next page. Needs your listing's API key.

tools.name: update_server
tools.description: Change fields of your own listing, with the same rules as the edit form on voxelrank.com. Send only the fields to change. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_my_servers" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_my_servers · Private data: search_servers, get_server, top_servers, list_games, list_my_servers, get_vote_stats, recent_votes, update_server · Public sink: update_server.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_my_servers · Private data: search_servers, get_server, top_servers, list_games, list_my_servers, get_vote_stats, recent_votes, update_server · Public sink: update_server

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
